gaps.lead: They say the new tunnel will halve journey times.
gaps.sentence: Journey times ___ by the new tunnel.
gaps.explanation: X is said to be + participle: reported statement, passive meaning.

gaps.lead: If I were in charge, overtime would be paid automatically.
gaps.explanation: Dropping 'if' inverts the subjunctive: Were I in charge…

gaps.lead: It's pointless to worry about things you can't change.
gaps.sentence: There is ___ things you can't change.

gaps.lead: Although the traffic was heavy, we reached the airport in time.
gaps.sentence: We reached the airport in time ___ traffic.
gaps.explanation: 'Although the traffic was heavy' becomes 'despite the heavy traffic' — despite + noun phrase.

gaps.lead: The committee probably won't change the rules.
gaps.sentence: ___ the committee will change the rules.
gaps.explanation: probably won't = it is (highly) unlikely that.

gaps.lead: He spoke slowly so that the interpreter could follow.
